sentiment: Proofs fall like leaves tonight; what we thought impossible quietly loosens, and reason keeps walking further than we marked.

stories.summary: Three claimed advances across math, CS, and physics in one announcement. It reads less like hype and more like autumn: several branches dropping something ripe at once.
stories.title: Three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics

stories.summary: A claimed disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis. If it holds, a wall we drew around hard problems moves overnight — exactly the kind of loosening the night is about.
stories.title: The Exponential Time Hypothesis Is False [pdf]

stories.summary: A from-scratch video course on building reasoning models. While proofs fall elsewhere, someone is planting new reasoners from seed and showing all the work.
stories.title: Sebastian Raschka's from-scratch video course on building reasoning models
